name: decline
notes: LOOKS LIKE: a slow deliberate 'no' done with the WRIST, not the base. The arm raises to a speaking pose, then joint5 and joint6 counter-rotate +/-28 deg through two full cycles — the hand shakes side to side at the end of a still forearm. Peak 25.5 deg/s, the fastest in the set and still under the 28 deg/s ceiling. JOINT1 IS ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT. Operator instruction at the arm: there are clamps on the sides of the base, so the base does not turn — the collision model cannot see those clamps, so the person standing there is the authority. hw_backend refuses any stream moving joint1 more than 2 deg. All expressiveness is joint2-joint6 plus the jaws. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Full-range revision, authorized 2026-08-30 ('i want you to fully use the arm not just slightly move it'); budgets are measured with arm/measure_range.py and every stream is MuJoCo self-collision-verified before a frame is sent.
